meta.title: Toolbox
meta.description: A resident tool button at the sidebar foot, at the right end of the account/Settings row: while the sidebar is wide it sits beside the Settings button, and the host settings row narrows to make room. It follows the sidebar layout, so it never floats over the session list or the Settings dialog; future tools join it as more icon buttons. The current tool, Element Picker: click the icon to pick, hover the live UI to highlight any element, use ↑/↓ to move between parent and child, and click to capture. Esc or a second click on the icon exits. Each capture is inserted into the current composer as a compact @label reference chip (capture several elements in a row); the conversation shows only a small chip, while the full captured context still travels with the message for the model. Type the change request after the chips. With no composer available the reference is copied instead. The button also works while the sidebar is collapsed to its rail.
